title: Harden capability fit: HTTP fetch is not a representative JavaScript browser
mission: Eliminate the residual preclaim ambiguity exposed by repeated Jose V12 ROUTE_ABORTED returns: a runtime that can search/fetch/navigate HTTP but has no tool that executes page JavaScript and DOM interaction must classify representative_javascript_browser as definitively absent before any PIN CREATE.
definition_of_done: Add a normative capability-fit rule to wc and FAST_ALLOCATION_PROTOCOL_V1.md stating that HTTP/search/fetch/navigation alone never satisfies representative_javascript_browser; absence of any JavaScript/DOM execution tool makes that capability definitively absent.

Extend fast_allocator_capability_fit_v1.mjs (or an equally bounded regression) with a runtime-profile fixture proving a web-fetch-only worker skips a representative_javascript_browser candidate preclaim and consumes zero authority CREATE attempts.
Preserve Unknown-is-not-absence for capabilities that truly cannot be resolved from the runtime tool surface; do not turn all unknown capabilities into mismatches.
Add or update Efficiency Ratchet coverage so this distinction cannot silently regress.
Reproduce the Jose V12 candidate and prove the web-fetch-only profile routes around it before authority while a representative-JS profile remains eligible.
Do not modify Jose product bytes or Current/Human Accepted/Served authority.
